entries.title: Jedi Tower 2000
entries.author: CWE_Darth_Opie

findings: Preserve the authored master COG rank 8 assignment and one 15-second timer, including startup fall-through. Its initial mana 200 assignment is superseded by subsequent newplayer initialization to rank*50 in both the original JK and MotS controllers. The timer later resets mana to 200. Weapon ordinals 1/2 remain compatible; the source JK saber 10 grant uses native MotS descriptor 131.

Native MotS force_well caches multiplayer mana maximum before episode startup; the exact local master edit sends startup to the existing inventory rank controller after its authored rank change. No native COG/resource override is installed. Native maxmana69 and regeneration then use rank8 with the class minimum intact.

The native SetPulse verb replaces one interval/deadline on the existing COG, so reinitialization does not register an additional repeating pulse. Authored rank/power availability and peer behavior require runtime checks; this is a prototype.
Original README and credits are preserved locally. Source-only conversion instructions do not grant asset redistribution rights.

Preserve authored camera, healing, particle stream, projectile traps, turret, crane, moving doors/elevators and sector thrust. Projectile/template arguments are not inventory slots. All14 environmental scripts were source-reviewed.
The reinitialization is guarded by native maximum < authored rank*50, so the unchanged rank assignment at15 seconds does not restart native regeneration cadence.

Controlled live inventory checks observed rank 8, native maximum 400 and initial mana 400, then mana 200 at the authored 15-second reset and further increments of four per second. The otherwise identical Heart negative control without rank-controller reinitialization retained maximum 0 and clamped mana to 0. This validates this specific behavior, not all map mechanics or peer parity.
